summary: The review's deterministic risk floor and its verdict schema: scripts/review-risk BASE HEAD scores a diff low, medium or high by the named rules in .st/review-risk.json (built on .st/risky-classes.json); scripts/review-validate checks a verdict against .st/review-verdict.schema.json and the rules a schema cannot say (final risk is the higher of the two scores, a GO has no blocking finding); docs/review.md describes both.
